comments.why: Short Curtis video on how sad news breeds passivity
comments.text: I have a sense part of that is the "Oh Dearism" - we just watch sad news each day and it makes us think all that can be done is say "oh dear" - reflected in this short video by Adam Curtis - [VIDEO] (also featuring Charlie Brooker, creator of Black Mirror)

comments.author: alecco
comments.story: Ask HN: What are pressing issues that will affect humanity this decade?
comments.why: Adam Curtis on oh dearism in news
comments.text: 1) Drought, expensive food, lack of freshwater (e.g. California, Nevada, Pakistan) NASA video on groundwater reserves [LINK] 2) Big Data takeover by government (citizen profiling) and private sector (financial and health discrimination) 3) Youth-based uprisings changing the political landscape (driven by unemployment) But I think all these issues will play a wake-up call. Societies will become less self-centered, with less nationalism, less exceptionalism, and with more involvement and cooperation. There is already a rise in positive social activism. Kids are watching less TV and young people don't read newspapers, I love that! Lies are quickly demystified on places like Twitter. The negative impact will matter mostly on how early people decide to get involved. [LINK] [LINK] ($0.30/gallon in US, not viable) [VIDEO] Adam Curtis on "Oh Dear"-ism
